name: Spirit & Steel
description:
About This Game



Wake up! You have been called to defend all you hold dear from the hands of the evil William Von Pingleton III and his robot army. Use the elemental powers the deity entrusted you with to eradicate these invaders. Pingleton's greed is corrupting the land you call home, but his metal minions are nothing compared to the weapons you wield.

As the last living line of defense, you'll use your powerful elemental arms to push, pound, and punch the robots who are polluting the ether and imprisoning the island spirits known as the Goubies. They don't take kindly to your strong winds, ruthless waves, and furious fire fists.

You won't let your aching joints and short stature stop you from winning the final fight. Face off against the master mind himself and prove yourself as a worthy guardian. Will you accept the island's call for help?



  • Air, water, and fire elemental powers
  • Three types of enemy robots
  • Hidden Goubies in need of rescue
  • A final boss fight



This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
short_desc: A 3rd person elemental combat game following an old shaman as she tries to save her spirit family from the evil, technologically advanced antagonist, William Von Pingleton III. She will use the powers gifted to her by the spirits to punch her way to victory!
